copy.hero_headline: Hair that behaves on the days you have no time
copy.hero_sub: A four-chair studio on Holland Street, by appointment.
about: We cut, colour and treat hair in a small room with four chairs and no music loud enough to shout over. Appointments are booked with a person rather than with the salon.
Consultations happen before anything is mixed. If what you have asked for will not work on the hair you have, you will be told so then, not afterwards.
copy.services_intro: What we do, and roughly how long to set aside.

services.name: Cut and finish

services.name: Colour and gloss
services.description: Single-process colour, root touch-ups and shine treatments.

services.description: Hand-painted and foiled lightening, done over more than one visit if it needs it.

services.name: Treatments
services.description: Bond-building and conditioning for hair that has had a hard year.

services.name: Blow-dry and styling
services.description: For a wedding, a photograph, or a Thursday.

services.name: Fringe trims
services.description: Between appointments, in and out in ten minutes.
